source_gates: Match exact author manifest and copy frozen sources/dependencies into a new isolated location.
Rebuild every positive source without sorry, admit, custom axiom or native_decide; retain full output/source/log SHA256.
Enumerate every declaration by originating compiled module, including generated/private names and all declaration kinds; a source regex or namespace inventory is insufficient.
Collect complete transitive axiom dependencies; reject any originating axiom declaration or dependency outside the three allowed standard axioms.

A work/value projection theorem alone does not certify implementation work. Trace cost units and coverage of every required source operation, global receipt-append volumes, initialization, pruning/refusal and continuation work.
Separate structural operation bounds, library/oracle contracts and input/counter bit-size assumptions from compiler/machine instruction or cycle claims.
Keep all three main milestones OPEN; a scoped source-work theorem does not prove source coverage, original residual components, raw mass or a full faster solver.
